verdict.rationale: Token2's FIDO2 FAQ has a section titled "How Do I Set Up a Backup Key?", so the vendor does address backup-key registration. The pack only shows that heading, not its guidance. The fido2-manage tool's SSH resident-key rehydrate feature touches recovery only tangentially. Missing for 10: the actual backup-key procedure content, any statement of what is and is not recoverable after key loss (e.g. non-exportable credentials, effects of factory reset), and independent corroboration.
